description: Redaction vectors for redactStatement() in src/lib/query-events/redact.ts. Each case pins the statement text an engine's query runs, the statement a query event stores under queryLog.statementCapture redacted, and its statement_fingerprint, the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of that statement. form names the construct a case exercises.

vectors.name: postgres: single-quoted literals become ? and double-quoted names stay
vectors.input: SELECT id, "Email" FROM "User" WHERE name = 'O''Brien' AND note = ''
vectors.statement: SELECT id, "Email" FROM "User" WHERE name = ? AND note = ?

vectors.name: postgres: E'' escape strings become ?
vectors.input: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE line LIKE E'%\t%' OR line = e'caf\u00e9'
vectors.statement: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE line LIKE ? OR line = ?

vectors.name: postgres: a quote behind a backslash cannot be settled, so the rest of the statement is masked
vectors.input: UPDATE notes SET body = E'it\'s', owner = 'ann' WHERE id = 7

vectors.name: postgres: N'' national strings become ?
vectors.input: INSERT INTO people (name, city) VALUES (N'Zoë', n'Köln')

vectors.name: postgres: dollar-quoted bodies, tagged or not, become ?
vectors.input: CREATE FUNCTION greet() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql AS $body$ SELECT 'hi; DROP TABLE t' $body$; SELECT $$it's$$
vectors.statement: CREATE FUNCTION greet() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql AS ?; SELECT ?

vectors.name: postgres: q'' is no PostgreSQL form, so it reads as names and literals and nothing quoted is kept
postgres: integers, decimals, exponents, hex and grouped digits become ?, and digits inside names stay
vectors.input: SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE a = 42 AND b > -3.14 AND c < 1.5e-5 AND d <> 0x1F AND e = 1_000 LIMIT 10
vectors.statement: SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE a = ? AND b > -? AND c < ? AND d <> ? AND e = ? LIMIT ?

vectors.name: postgres: a -- comment becomes ?
vectors.input:
SELECT id -- owner is ann@example.com
FROM accounts

vectors.name: postgres: block comments nest and each becomes one ?
postgres: # is an operator, not a comment
postgres: array literals and subscripts are code, so the literals inside them become ?
vectors.input: SELECT ARRAY['a', 'b'], tags[1], m['k'] FROM t WHERE ids = ANY('{1,2}')
vectors.statement: SELECT ARRAY[?, ?], tags[?], m[?] FROM t WHERE ids = ANY(?)

vectors.name: postgres: B'', X'' and U&'' literals become ?, typed literals keep their type, and U&"" names stay
vectors.input: SELECT B'1010', X'1F', U&'d\0061t', interval '1 day', DATE '2024-01-31', U&"d\0061t"

vectors.name: postgres: a role password is a literal and becomes ?
vectors.input: ALTER ROLE app WITH LOGIN PASSWORD 'hunter2' VALID UNTIL '2027-01-01'
vectors.statement: ALTER ROLE app WITH LOGIN PASSWORD ? VALID UNTIL ?

vectors.name: postgres: the userinfo of a URI written as code is masked
postgres: whitespace collapses to single spaces and the ends are trimmed
postgres: a quoted name that never closes keeps nothing from its quote on
mysql: single- and double-quoted strings become ?
vectors.input: SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = 'O''Brien' AND city = "Berlin"
vectors.statement: SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = ? AND city = ?

mysql: N'', charset-introduced, hex and bit literals become ?
mysql: a dollar-quoted run becomes ?
mysql: q'' is no MySQL form, so the q stays and the literal becomes ?
mysql: numbers become ?
vectors.input: UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance - 250.75 WHERE id = 17 LIMIT 1
vectors.statement: UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance - ? WHERE id = ? LIMIT ?

vectors.name: mysql: a -- comment becomes ?

DELETE FROM sessions -- expired for ann@example.com
